content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible in [product_name] [version_no] to download to multiple [product_name] devices at once using a single command? Or does each device require a separate download? Thanks for your response, [user_name]

No, downloads must be completed one at a time. The software only supports one IP address and connection at once. Alternatively, you could use a memory card for downloading instead of a computer, unless each device needs a unique IP address, which complicates things further.

The discussion reveals a limitation for bulk operations within the current software version.
